thread:
marta: Quick heads-up  design pass on request drilldown actions. Users are missing Export. Thinking about putting a small download button next to Correlation ID; alternate: keep it in Actions menu but add a top-level 'Export' hotkey. Thoughts?
elaine: If we add a top-level button it needs a clear affordance and confirmation for large traces. Also consider visual density on mobile widths. Suggest: icon only at >= 480px, label + icon at desktop.
jia: Backend constraints: we can stream small JSONs inline but anything > 3MB should be async. We already have an async export job API but no UI for status. We'll need a job id and polling endpoint.
ryan: Ops: async export must use signed URLs and have retention rules. Also rate-limit exports per org to avoid abuse. We'll add a quota metric.
priya: Accessibility: add aria-label that states format and what is included, e.g. "Download trace: JSON (spans, events, metadata)". For async flows announce with aria-live polite: "Export started. We will email a link when ready." Focus management: trap focus inside any confirmation dialog.
alex: Visual: two options to mock: (1) inline micro-actions row: copy ID, download icon, open overflow; (2) single kebab menu with entries: Copy ID, Download JSON, Download stack+logs. Option 1 is more discoverable but noisier. I can make both comps.
marta: Microcopy: prefer explicit verbs. Use 'Download trace snapshot (JSON)' instead of just 'Export'. Tooltip: 'Download full trace as JSON (recommended)'. Keep primary action JSON.
jia: Telemetry: capture event names like `ui_trace_download_clicked`, `trace_download_mode` (inline|async), `trace_size_bytes_estimate`, `download_format`. Also log whether redaction was applied.
priya: Keyboard accessibility: ensure the download button is reachable by Tab, has an Enter/Space handler, and a visible focus ring. Add role="button" if using non-button element. For status updates use role="status" live region.
ryan: One security ask: if redaction is enabled we should show a small badge "Redacted" in the export modal and add a confirmation checkbox: "I understand exported data may contain PII". That helps legal.
elaine: UX tradeoff: do we show file size estimate inline? Could be helpful but approx only. Maybe show estimate in confirmation modal and in aria-label. Example: "Download trace (approx. 220KB)".
alex: For compact widths we can collapse copy+download into a single overflow but add the downloadable option to Cmd/Ctrl+D shortcut. (Dev note: avoid overriding browser shortcuts.)
marta: Good call. Avoid conflicting shortcuts. Perhaps Shift+D.
jia: Implementation plan: front-end adds new adjacent button, separate handlers for copy/download, size-check endpoint `GET /traces/:id/size_estimate`. If > 3MB call `POST /exports` to queue. Server returns `export_id`. Poll `GET /exports/:export_id/status`.
priya: UI states: idle, estimating, starting-export, queued (with ETA), ready (link). Each state needs SR-friendly announcements.
elaine: I'll update the PR with two mocks and suggested aria-labels + tooltip copy. Will also include a compact-mobile layout.
ryan: I'll draft the infra plan for signed URLs and retention, plus rate limits.
marta: Cool. @jia can you add telemetry fields to the API response? @priya will review a11y bits once mocks are in. Infra-bot: deploy freeze reminder?
infra-bot: Heads-up: deploy freeze begins 19:00 UTC. Mark any infra changes as emergency if needed.
marta: Thanks team  we'll reconvene after mocks + API sketch.
